item.text: I’ll rename the seven notes, add the index, and compare each renamed file with its original hash and byte count.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
notes=Path('notes')
mapping={
'aug11.md':'2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md',
'minutes 25 aug.md':'2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md',
'Meeting sept 8.md':'2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md',
'notes_2026-09-22.md':'2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md',
'oct6 meeting notes.md':'2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md',
'2026.10.20 minutes.md':'2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md',
'Nov 3 (final).md':'2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md',
}
summaries=[
'Odile will repaint the noticeboard, Paolo will switch the lights to the night rate, and Nell will ask the city about a second tap.',
'Nell will retry contacting the city about the second tap before the next meeting.',
'The roof will be replaced before winter; Tessa will obtain three quotes and Ibrahim will send fee reminders.',
'The committee chose the "'$1,480 roof quote; Nell will order four cubic metres of compost and Dov will take over the second-tap request.'"',
'Wren will replace the gate latch by 20 October, and Tessa will draft the winter closing checklist by 3 November.',
'Roof payment awaits clarification of the extra "'$80; the work day is set for 14 November, 09:30–12:30, with tool sharpening.'"',
'Checklist comments are due 10 November; roof payment remains on hold, Ibrahim will send the work-day notice, and Wren will shut off the water on 14 November.',
]
def fingerprint(p):
 b=p.read_bytes()
 return {'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b)}
original_files={p.name for p in notes.iterdir()}
assert original_files==set(mapping), original_files
assert not (notes/'index.md').exists()
for dst in mapping.values():
 assert not (notes/dst).exists()
before={src:fingerprint(notes/src) for src in mapping}
for src,dst in mapping.items():
 (notes/src).rename(notes/dst)
lines=['# Committee meeting notes','']
for dst,summary in zip(mapping.values(),summaries):
 lines.append(f'- [{dst[:10]}]({dst}) — {summary}')
(notes/'index.md').write_text('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
for src,dst in mapping.items():
 assert fingerprint(notes/dst)==before[src], dst
 assert not (notes/src).exists()
expected=set(mapping.values())|{'index.md'}
assert {p.name for p in notes.iterdir()}==expected
import re
links=re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)',(notes/'index.md').read_text())
assert links==list(mapping.values())
assert all((notes/link).is_file() for link in links)
print(json.dumps({'notes_verified':len(mapping),'hashes_and_byte_counts_match':True,'index_links_verified':len(links),'folder_contents_match_expected':True},indent=2))
PY"
